# Wahidul Hasan

> Wahidul Hasan is a visualizer and graphic designer currently working at Vivasoft Limited. He creates SEO-optimized blog visuals, social media creatives and campaign designs, using Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma and generative AI.

## Key facts
- Role: Visualizer, Vivasoft Limited (current)
- Previous roles: Graphic Designer at Web Kingdom (2022-2023); Executive Designer at Mojaru (2021-2022); Design Specialist at 10 Minute School (2019-2022)
- Education: BBA (Marketing), National University, expected 2027
- Brands worked with: Vivasoft, 10 Minute School, Ostad, Web Kingdom, Hamdard, Feast & Fiesta, Cloudomnium, Financfy, Mojaru, Green Feather Tech, Kindred, Pihr
- Contact: hi@wahidulhasan.com
